name: sympy_solve
description: Symbolic mathematics with sympy: solve equations, simplify, expand, factor, differentiate, integrate (indefinite or definite), limits and series, with exact results as sympy text, LaTeX and a decimal value when numeric. One expression per call; the variable is inferred when there is one.

expression.description: sympy syntax (x**2, sin(x), exp(x), pi, E, oo; ^ allowed); for solve, an equation lhs = rhs or an expression equal to zero

symbol.description: The variable; default: the single free symbol, or x

point.description: Limit point or series expansion point (default 0); oo for infinity

lower.description: Lower bound of a definite integral

upper.description: Upper bound of a definite integral

catalog.source: sympy 1.13 (https://www.sympy.org); the sandbox image pins sympy 1.13.3
